selection: highest recovered count on training with >=99.5% proxy precision; independent validation gate, no validation retuning
identity_rule: same contiguous provider track_id and same roster ID on both sides; no motion identity guesses
control_rule: same named owner anchors, same team, continuous player observations, uncontested <=2m interpolated ball corridor
limitations: Withheld provider IDs and proximity associations are surrogate references, not independent human truth.
Automatic provider identity mistakes can persist.
Synthetic missingness may differ from natural missingness.
